mapLocation.label: Talk to any guard around the Sinclair Mansion, north of Seers' Village and Camelot.

itemsRequired.howToGet: Buy on the Grand Exchange, or from Rimmington General Store in Rimmington for 1 gp.

route.title: Walkthrough
steps: Talk to the guard out front of Sinclair Mansion and agree to help. Dialogue: "Sure, I'll help."
Go north-west and investigate the sacks in the shed, take 4 flypapers.
Go inside the mansion and take the pungent pot and criminal's dagger.
Investigate the smashed window on the eastern side for the criminal's thread.
Search the barrels in the bedroom owned by the following two suspects to get 2 silver items.
Go to the kitchen and fill your pot with flour from the barrel.
Use flour and flypaper to dust each silver item and the dagger.
Use the silver items' prints on the dagger's print until you get a match. Remember who it is.
Talk to Gossip outside the front gate of the mansion and ask who he thinks is responsible. Dialogue: "Who do you think was responsible?"

Talk to the poison salesman in the Seers' Village pub, ask who he sold poison to. (Select Murder Mystery quest) (Be sure to not select the Fremennik Trials option.) Dialogue: "Who did you sell Poison to at the house?"
Talk to the person whose prints matched, ask why they bought poison. Dialogue: "Why'd you buy poison the other day?"
Search the item they say they used the poison on.
Drop the silver necklace (if you took it from Anna's barrel) before talking to the guard if you want to keep it, you can't get it back afterward.
Talk to a guard. Dialogue: "I know who did it!"
